sections.怎么用:
Send the following 18 questions to candidate vendors and request written answers with documentation links. A verbal promise is insufficient.

- Record an unsupported “yes” as unknown.
- For a “no”, ask for an alternative arrangement.
- The six groups follow procurement order: identity and data, then logs and models, then contract and exit.
sections.第一组：身份与账号:
1. Which SSO protocols (SAML / OIDC) are supported? Is SCIM provisioning and deprovisioning available?
2. What is the maximum delay before a departing employee loses access? Can sessions be forcibly invalidated?
3. Which administrator roles exist? Who may change organisation policies and billing?
4. Can data be isolated by team or project instead of sharing one organisation-wide space?
sections.第二组：数据与训练:
5. Is customer data used for model training by default? Where is the opt-out, and can it be enforced organisation-wide?
6. In which region is data stored? Can a region be specified or data residency contractually guaranteed?
7. How long is data retained? Can retention be customised and data deleted after export?
8. Where are uploaded files, conversations and generated content retained? Can each be deleted separately?
sections.第三组：日志与审计:
9. Which events do audit logs cover: sign-in, permission changes, policy changes and data export?
10. Can logs be exported to a SIEM, S3 or webhook? What is the export delay?
11. How long are audit logs retained, and can administrators inspect historical events?
12. Is there a log-retrieval API, and what are its rate limits?
sections.第四组：模型与能力:
13. Which models are used and how are versions identified? How much advance notice is provided before a model is retired or replaced?
14. Can customers bring their own model or API key? Which providers are supported?
15. Can preview features be disabled organisation-wide? How can production versions be pinned?
sections.第五组：合同与许可:
16. Who owns intellectual property in outputs? Does commercial use cover the team's intended deliverables?
17. Are a data processing agreement (DPA) and a subprocessor list available? Which security certifications are held, such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001?
sections.第六组：退出: 18. How can all data be exported when the contract ends? In what format, and how long does it take? When are accounts and integrations disabled?
sections.权限矩阵模板:
Copy this into a spreadsheet and adapt the role names to your organisation:

| Capability | Member | Team administrator | Organisation administrator | Security/audit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Everyday use | Allowed | Allowed | Allowed | Allowed |
| Invite/disable members | Denied | Allowed | Allowed | Read-only |
| Change organisation policy | Denied | Denied | Allowed | Read-only |
| View audit logs | Denied | Own team | Whole organisation | Allowed |
| Export audit logs | Denied | Denied | Allowed | Allowed |
| Change billing/seats | Denied | Denied | Allowed | Read-only |

Principles: minimise administrator numbers, keep security/audit read-only and separate billing permissions from policy permissions.
sections.季度审计 6 项:
- [ ] Accounts: reconcile departures against deactivation records.
- [ ] Seats: reconcile paid seats with active accounts and reclaim dormant seats.
- [ ] Policies: record changes to training opt-outs, retention and outbound-data restrictions.
- [ ] Logs: verify that events for the last 90 days can be exported.
- [ ] Integrations: maintain an inventory of third-party applications and MCP servers; remove unused ones.
- [ ] Incidents: record whether data disclosures or mistaken actions occurred this quarter, with an incident review or a record of none.
sections.官方依据:
| Question group | Official references to inspect |
|---|---|
| Identity/roles | Claude Enterprise Administrator Guide; OpenAI Help Center tenant administration; Cursor Enterprise documentation |
| Audit logs | OpenAI security settings and audit logs; Claude Compliance API; Cursor `GET /teams/audit-logs` |
| Data region/retention | Each vendor's privacy policy and DPA; Google Cloud audit-log configuration; Microsoft Purview |
| Model versions | Vendor model pages and release notes; preview policies in official documentation |
| Exit | Vendor data-export documentation and contract terms |
sections.核验事实:
1. Cursor Admin API uses `GET /teams/audit-logs`, limited to 20 requests per minute per team (official documentation; recorded check 2026-11-03).
2. Claude Enterprise roles are Primary Owner / Owner / Member; audit and retention are provided through the Compliance API (official administrator guide; recorded check 2026-11-03).
3. OpenAI tenant audit logs are under Global settings → Security → Audit logs; workspace audit visibility depends on role (Help Center; recorded check 2026-11-03).
4. Gemini Enterprise prompt/response logging is off by default; data-access auditing must be enabled in Cloud Logging (official documentation; recorded check 2026-11-03).
5. Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions enter the unified audit log; Purview handles eDiscovery and retention (Microsoft Learn; recorded check 2026-11-03).
6. Certifications and contract terms vary by vendor and tier. Use current documentation from the contracting entity; this site does not endorse a vendor.
